ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), RecordType.Name = 'Pricing Approval', NOT(ISBLANK(Opportunity__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Opportunity__r.Pricing_Approval__c))), ISPICKVAL ( Opportunity__r.Pricing_Approval__c , "Approved") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: There is an existing approved pricing approval. You are not allowed to create another pricing approval. If you would like to submit a new pricing approval, please recall the existing approved approval.
